# SeaBankExtension - SQL Shortcut Runner for VS Code

## Project Overview
A VS Code extension that allows users to define custom keyboard shortcuts mapped to SQL query templates. When triggered, it substitutes the selected text into the query and executes it via the MSSQL extension.

## Tech Stack
- TypeScript
- VS Code Extension API
- MSSQL Extension API integration

## Key Features
- Sidebar panel with shortcut management
- Add/edit/delete custom key+query shortcuts
- Execute queries with selected text substitution
- Results displayed in MSSQL query results panel
